0:
Sigh... One way or another, we've gathered
six of the scattered Cards.
2:
Well, it was trouble after trouble, like I
expected, but I'm glad we didn't get the
huge disaster I was worried about.
4:
I hope the last one ends peacefully too...
without any trouble, if possible.
6: Hm? Oh, Ikaros. Sorry, I was lost in thought.
7:
No, if you are busy, Master, I can come
back another time...
8:
Nah, it's fine. I'm bored anyway. And I'm not
in the mood to read porn mags.
9:
Then, Master... would you please read
this?
15: Um, Master... did I do something wrong?
21:
Wh-Why would you... I mean, do you even
know what a love letter is?
22: No... actually, I don't really understand.
24:
(...Man, that surprised me. My heart's
pounding harder than it did through all the
fuss over the six Cards so far.)
25:
(Hm? Why is my heart pounding this hard? I'm
way too surprised.)
26:
(Well, not that I've ever gotten a love
letter in my whole life!)
27:
...So, why'd you suddenly write a love
letter? You don't even really get what one
is.
28:
...There are many things I don't
understand.
29:
Master, you often tell me to be more
human, but I don't really understand what
being human means.
30:
I don't understand what this thing called
love is, which all humans know.
31:
Because of that, I'm always troubling you,
Master...
32:
Well, I do want you to be more human, but
it's not like you're troubling me...
33: But how does that lead to a love letter?
34:
Yes... I wanted to know about love, so I
asked various people.
35:
For example, the President said she feels
affection when grinding the tip of her heel
into someone lying down.
36: So, while you were sleeping, Master, I too...
37:
Whoa, whoa, hold it! You were doing stuff
like that?!
38:
No... Nymph told me it was too niche and to
drop it, so...
39:
That was close... You can't let your guard
down for a second with that cold-blooded
woman...
40:
And then... Sohara-san said that reading
love letters might give me some ideas.
41:
For some reason, I had received a lot of
love letters.
42:
...Come to think of it, you were pretty
popular at school. Even though you're an
unidentified life-form.
43:
I reread them many times, and tried writing
a love letter in my own way.
44:
Master... if you don't mind, would you read
it?
45: Y-Yeah... well, if that's how it is.
47:
(Knowing Ikaros, she probably just wrote
something weird again anyway, but...)
50:
Master. I am happy when I am with you,
Master.
52:
I am happy that you show me so many
things, Master.
53:
I am happy that you teach me so many
things, Master.
54:
The sea, festivals, baths, school,
watermelons, the zoo, camping...
55:
I am happy being with you, Master, but are
you happy, Master?
56:
I think I must do my best too, so that you
will want to be with me too, Master, and be
happy being with me.
57:
...It made my heart skip a little at first, but
well, figures it'd be like this.
58: Um... is it not a proper love letter?
59:
Well, it's not really a love letter. I'm glad
about the feelings, though.
61:
It seems I really can't understand love
after all...
62:
Someone like me can never become human
like you say, Master...
63:
No, like I said, Ikaros. You don't have to
worry about that so much...
69:
I-It doesn't mean anything weird, okay?
You're down over something silly, so I just
wanted to cheer you up a bit.
72:
...But y'know, Ikaros. I don't really get what
love is either.
73:
Seeing someone who's down and wanting to
cheer them up... I think that counts as love
too.
74:
You can understand that much, can't you,
Ikaros?
76:
(...She's an unidentified life-form, and yet
this is weirdly embarrassing.)
77:
(Oh, I'm still holding that love letter. I
should probably put it down somewhere...)
79:
Isn't that a Card stuck to the back of this
love letter?!
80:
...Confirmed. This is the missing seventh
Card.
81:
What's more, it appears to have already
been activated.
83:
It should have... but I couldn't even detect
it when it activated, so its effect must
have been very small.
84:
This was stuck to your love letter, right?
So does that mean it reacted to your wish,
Ikaros?
85:
No, I don't think so. I'm an Angeloid, so I
don't have wishes.
87:
Mine? ...Come to think of it, I did hope the
last one would wrap up without any
trouble.
88:
If that's what came true, then it makes
sense that it activated and nothing
happened.
89:
Anyway, that's a load off my shoulders at
last. Phew, what a relief.
90:
I'm all drained, so I'm gonna go take a
breather in my room. Oh, and don't come in.
93: ...I'm an Angeloid, so I don't have wishes.
94:
But... perhaps what this last Card granted
was my wish...
